'''Electrical Wiring''' is a Circuits component used in [[Odyssey Engineering]] for suit and laser-weapon modifications. Its in-game description identifies it as multipurpose wiring for electronic devices.

It belongs to the Odyssey on-foot material inventory. It is not a ship cargo commodity and is separate from similarly named ship Engineering materials such as Heat Conduction Wiring.

== Uses ==

Electrical Wiring is consumed by these suit modifications:

* Faster Shield Regen for Artemis, [[Dominator Suit|Dominator]], and Maverick suits;
* [[Improved Battery Capacity]] for Artemis, Dominator, and Maverick suits;
* [[Reduced Tool Battery Consumption]] for Artemis, Dominator, and Maverick suits.

It is also used for Improved Hip Fire Accuracy on the TK Aphelion, TK Eclipse, and TK Zenith laser weapons. Current community component records list 12 applicable modification recipes in total.<ref name="inara-wiring">[https://inara.cz/elite/component/191/ INARA: Electrical Wiring], accessed 13 September 2026.</ref>

Electrical Wiring is used for modifications rather than for increasing a suit or weapon's grade.

== Acquisition ==

Electrical Wiring can be obtained from:

* containers and lockers in industrial (IND) settlement buildings;
* containers and lockers in command (CMD) settlement buildings;
* on-foot mission rewards;
* barter with a station or settlement bartender in the Circuits category.

Container contents vary between settlements and visits, so the building type improves the search odds rather than guaranteeing a unit. When bartering, Electrical Wiring has a listed Circuits cost of 9 and value of 5; those are exchange weights, not credit prices.<ref name="inara-wiring" />

== Collection priorities ==

Commanders planning battery, shield-regeneration, tool-efficiency, or laser hip-fire modifications should retain Electrical Wiring rather than treating every unit as barter stock. The required amount depends on the planned modifications, so a loadout tracker is useful before exchanging surplus components.

Because Circuits can be bartered against other Circuits, repeatedly looting a well-stocked industrial or command settlement can also provide alternative components that can be exchanged for Electrical Wiring.
